exposure: Cervical dilation at diagnosis of labor dystocia
Cervical dilation at diagnosis of dystocia and initiation of oxytocin-infusion (≤ 5 cm, 6-10 cm, fully dilated)
risk assessment on admission to the labor ward
Cervical dilation at initiation of oxytocin infusion
cohort: Nulliparous women at term with spontaneous onset of labor and dystocia requiring oxytocin augmentation
finding: While there was no difference in the risk of operative birth between women who received oxytocin augmentation at ≤ 5 cm and 6-10 cm cervical dilation, the cesarean section rate was highest in women who received oxytocin augmentation at ≤ 5 cm.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was highest in women who received oxytocin augmentation at ≤ 5 cm cervical dilation.
